evidence_status: Researcher-defined exploratory configuration; not elicited organisational policy; not reproduction of historical 29-rule norm
timing_policy: Only endpoint timestamps within this explicit broad plausibility range are usable; this does not certify extraction date. Nonnegative first-IR to first-CI lag only.
maturity_policy: Sensitivity only: last plausible recorded event no later than reference date minus 60 days. Not a known completion/censoring truth label.
resource_identity_policy: Human proxy only explicit user_[0-9]+ identities; batch_[0-9]+ is observed automation identity; NONE/empty/other labels unevaluable, never silently human or automated
lag_interpretation: First IR to first CI is a first-endpoint trace proxy; it does not match multiple invoices/receipts/clearings into individual invoice cycles
primary_reference: mean of all scored cases for the stated configuration

criteria.name: No recorded invoice receipt
criteria.evidence_policy: absence within recorded history, not proof of non-completion

criteria.name: No recorded clearing
criteria.evidence_policy: absence within recorded history, not proof of non-completion

criteria.name: No recorded goods or service receipt
Long observed invoice-to-clearing lag
criteria.evidence_policy: both first timestamps observed and plausible; nonnegative lag

criteria.name: Invoice precedes goods or service receipt
criteria.evidence_policy: both first timestamps observed and plausible; equality permitted

criteria.name: Recorded human touches
criteria.evidence_policy: every event resource usable; missing event resource makes full count unevaluable

criteria.name: Distinct recorded human resources
criteria.evidence_policy: every event resource usable; missing event resource makes full count unevaluable

view_weight_policy: Each criterion receives its layer's stated raw weight; these are per-criterion weights, not target layer totals.
tie_policy: descending index, then descending scored support, then lexicographic group key; top-k overlap includes eligible zero-priority ties and reports positive-group counts
claim_boundary: Recorded concern under illustrative settings; no validated ownership, actual labour effort, causal diagnosis, financial loss or intervention-effect claim
